title: Meridian Biosciences - Evaluation Workbook and Private Dataset Ledger
content:
Purpose:
This workbook captures the model onboarding acceptance criteria, pinned prompt set, private dataset ledger, and regression plan for Meridian Biosciences (internal name MBio). The goal is to produce a reproducible, auditable signoff artifact that ties quality metrics to dataset slices and pinned prompts. Use this document during model certification and for rollback/runbook references after deployment.

Scope and constraints:
- Scope: text-generation assistant for clinical trial eligibility screening (short-form summaries and binary eligibility flags). Not in scope: free-form clinical advice, medical recommendation generation.
- Model candidates: open-weights family X (quantized 4-bit) and Redwood-verified variant X-small (latency-optimized).
- Deployment target: Dedicated cluster (EU region), VPC-only access, KMS-managed keys.
- Data: proprietary MBio de-identified trial intake records (private dataset ledger below). No customer PII present; privacy review attached in Confluence.

Private dataset ledger (authoritative):
- dataset_id: MBIOINTAKE_2024Q4 (stored in S3 path: s3://mbio-prod/datasets/intake/2024Q4/)
content_addendum:
- records: 18,452 intake forms, fields used: free_text_symptoms, age_range, prior_conditions_tag, medication_list, trial_id
- labeling: 5,200 human-labeled eligibility outcomes (label schema v2.1), labelers: Meridian clinical ops; inter-annotator agreement (Cohen kappa) = 0.82
- allowed_splits: train=80%, validation=10%, holdout=10% (holdout reserved for post-deployment regression tests)

Pinned prompts (locked for rollout):
NOTE: Pinned prompts are the canonical prompts used for acceptance testing and must be included in any regression suite. Do not edit without a formal change request and re-run of signoff metrics.
1) Eligibility short answer (classification + explanation):
Prompt: "Given the intake record below, output a single line JSON with keys: {eligible: yes|no, reason: short-plain-text}. Use the label schema and do not include PHI.
Record: {{free_text_symptoms}} | age: {{age_range}} | prior: {{prior_conditions_tag}} | meds: {{medication_list}}"
Acceptance check: JSON parseable, eligible matches human label, reason length <= 140 chars.

2) Edge case: polypharmacy conflict detection (safety):
Prompt: "List any medications that conflict with trial {{trial_id}} exclusion rules and return a severity score (low|medium|high). Prioritize conflicts by severity."
Acceptance check: precision@3 >= 0.90 on labeled conflict set.

3) Hallucination stress test (contradiction sensitivity):
Prompt: "From the record below, does the patient meet inclusion criteria? Answer 'yes' or 'no' and list evidence lines from the record (max 3)."
Acceptance check: evidence lines must map to tokens present in the input (no invented facts), evidence recall >= 0.95 on canonical set.

Evaluation matrix (primary metrics):
- Accuracy (binary eligibility) on labeled test set (min threshold: 0.92)
- F1-score for eligible=Yes class (min threshold: 0.89)
- Precision for medication-conflict detection (min threshold: 0.90)
- Hallucination / factuality (evidence recall >= 0.95, hallucination rate <= 0.03 measured by manual audit)
- Latency (p95 token latency <= 320ms on Dedicated EU cluster)
- Cost-per-1000-tokens projection: baseline must be below $1.10 on candidate configuration

Regression gate design and test slate:
- Regression buckets (holdout):
  * Demographic slices: age<18 (pediatric), age>=65 (geriatric), non-English primary (translated intake)
  * Clinical complexity: 0–2 meds, 3–5 meds, >5 meds (polypharmacy)
  * Rare conditions: label-rare set (n=420)
- For each bucket run: accuracy delta <= 0.01 relative to baseline; if delta > 0.01, model fails the gate and requires triage.
- High-severity regression (medication conflict precision drop > 0.03) triggers automatic rollback to previous model variant and an incident ticket (ML-7819).

Manual audit plan (sampling):
- Pre-rollout: random sample 200 holdout records + stratified sample 150 from rare/complex buckets for a manual QA panel.
- Post-rollout (first 72 hours): sample first 500 production requests, include human-in-the-loop review for any case flagged uncertain by model (confidence < 0.65).
- Audit logging: redact tokens through pipeline, store model outputs, input hash, prompt id, and annotator notes in secure audit bucket for 90 days.

Operational readiness checklist (must be green before canary):
- [ ] Model pinned artifact in model registry with checksum and quant flag
- [ ] End-to-end test run with pinned prompt set (all acceptance checks pass)
- [ ] Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, 25% for 24h, 100% after 72h with automated rollback policy enabled
- [ ] Alerting: p95 latency, error-rate, hallucination-rate; pager rotations assigned
- [ ] Data access docs and KMS key scoped to MBio VPC

Signoff matrix (roles and acceptance fields):
- Applied ML Lead: Aisha Khan (confirm metrics meet thresholds; review audit sample)
- Solutions Eng: Rina Patel (confirm integration and routing, latency)
- Security/Compliance: Elena Gomez (confirm dataset ledger and KMS scopes)
- Customer PO (Meridian): Dr. Lucas Wright (confirm clinical acceptance)

Signoff entry template (to be copied into Confluence and as a release artifact):
- model_id: <registry-id>
- variant: <X-small-quant4>
- test_run_id: <ci-run-20250301-#>
- metrics_snapshot: {accuracy: 0.927, f1_yes: 0.895, conflict_precision: 0.912, hallucination_rate: 0.017, p95_latency_ms: 310}
- signoffs: [Aisha Khan, Rina Patel, Elena Gomez, Dr. Lucas Wright]

Change control and pinned prompt rotation policy:
- Any change to pinned prompts requires a documented change request (CR) with a re-run of acceptance metrics and manual audit. CRs tracked under ML-CR-2025.*.
- Minor text changes (typo fixes) allowed by Eng Lead with recorded diff and re-run of unit prompt test harness; substantive semantic edits require full re-certification.

Open questions / follow-ups (action items):
1) Confirm legal review of translated intake forms for non-English QA (owner: Elena Gomez, due: 2025-03-05).
2) Confirm final cost projection against dedicated cluster pricing with infra (owner: Marcus Lee, due: 2025-02-25).
3) Agree on production confidence threshold that routes to human-in-the-loop (owner: Dr. Wright + Solutions Eng, due: 2025-02-28).

Appendices:
A. Short sample records and expected outputs (10 canonical pinned cases) — stored under s3://mbio-prod/qa/pinned-prompts/
B. Label schema v2.1 (definitions for eligible/reason codes) — see Confluence linked artifact
C. Regression runbook (triage steps and debugging notebooks) — PR link above

Notes to reviewers:
- This workbook intentionally pairs locked prompt IDs with dataset ledger entries to make downstream audits straightforward. When you review, focus first on the pinned prompt wording and the accept/reject thresholds; these are the highest friction items for the customer.
- If you have an edit to a pinned prompt, add a line to the CR queue and do not push changes directly into the test harness.

Document history:
- 2025-02-18 initial draft (Aisha Khan)
- 2025-02-22 added pinned prompts and metric thresholds (Marcus Lee)
- 2025-02-27 updated regression buckets and canary plan after infra scoping (Sofia Martinez)
- 2025-03-01 formalized signoff template and added linked PR (Aisha Khan)
